spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid for the app, Bento Grid for the marketing site. Sharp edges.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFB300] text-black hover:bg-[#FFA000] font-semibold px-6 py-3 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-black border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 px-6 py-3 transition-colors

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white border border-gray-200 p-6 flex flex-col gap-4
cards.pricing_card: bg-white border border-gray-200 p-8 flex flex-col gap-6 relative

inputs.style: w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-none bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFB300] focus:border-transparent transition-all

headers.marketing: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-gray-200/50
headers.dashboard: sticky top-0 z-40 w-full bg-white border-b border-gray-200 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2%) for depth on flat backgrounds
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton using Grid Borders strategy for the dashboard (border-r, border-b)
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm max for strict technical feel

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Romanian (RO) language for all visible UI text on the landing page and dashboard.
Implement the 'Swiss Brutalist' aesthetic: minimal rounded corners, high contrast borders, generous whitespace.

For the Landing page Hero: Use a large compelling headline in IBM Plex Sans (e.g., 'Automatizarea Documentelor pentru Ingineria Gazelor'), an amber primary CTA, and place 'hero_background' image alongside or lightly layered behind.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for Marketing layouts. Use customized Shadcn UI components for the Dashboard and Forms.
Dashboard must utilize the 'Control Room Grid' layout (tight gaps, 1px borders, data-dense look).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-template-btn').
Dashboard must include sidebar navigation and top-right user profile/settings.
In the Form view for the Document Editor, generate inputs dynamically. Use standard Shadcn Input components with square/sharp edges.
